selection_basis: Both 100-step all12 probes have finite gradients, positive matching-boundary scale movement, moving attention weights, and no teacher gradients. On identical deterministic images, the main profile has lower final CE, KD, and feature error than the conservative profile; retain the predeclared main settings.
diagnostic_v0_caveat: Retained diagnostic_v0 reports contain an invalid scale_max_change comparison between initial LN1 and final LN2. Use the corrected named-boundary reports above. Initial v0 probes also overlapped checkpoint-safety-only source edits and do not establish exact full-run source identity.
